mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id AS MENU_ID, m.parent_id AS PARENT_ID, m.menu_name AS MENU_NAME, m.menu_name_en AS MENU_NAME_EN, m.menu_name_ko AS MENU_NAME_KO, m.menu_path AS MENU_PATH, m.icon AS ICON, m.sort_order AS SORT_ORDER, MAX(p.can_view) AS CAN_VIEW, MAX(p.can_edit) AS CAN_EDIT, MAX(p.can_delete) AS CAN_DELETE, MAX(p.can_download) AS CAN_DOWNLOAD, MAX(p.can_upload) AS CAN_UPLOAD, MAX(p.can_unmask) AS CAN_UNMASK FROM cm_menu m JOIN cm_role_menu_perm p ON p.menu_id = m.menu_id JOIN cm_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = p.role_id WHERE ur.user_seq = #{userSeq} GROUP BY m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_name_en, m.menu_name_ko, m.menu_path, m.icon, m.sort_order HAVING MAX(p.can_access) = 1 ORDER BY m.sort_order
